en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Renaissance-style town hall on a broad market square. The multi-gabled building has many windows, a central balcony and entrance staircase, and a small tower with a spire on the roof. People in old-fashioned clothing and a horse-drawn carriage are visible in the square. At the top in red print is the caption "Wittenberg a. d. Elbe. Rathaus."
